ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central-proximal regions, contrasted with 25% low-intensity black pixels forming the lateral margins and interior mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the center of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border on lateral edges. A dense field of fine, irregular black speckles is located on the lower-middle quadrant of both lobes. A distinct, high-contrast black elliptical spot is located on the mid-lateral section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The visible portion of the central division forms a sharp V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 40 degrees; the vertex point is submerged in the splash zone.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. The right lobe distal margin exhibits multiple sharp, triangular peaks (5-12 pixels in amplitude) and jagged valleys. The left lobe distal margin shows more rounded, low-amplitude crenulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lateral margins exhibit a strong convex curvature transitioning into narrow, pointed distal tips (flukes are oriented upwards).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) are scattered across the white fields of both lobes, suggesting localized scarring or prior colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear streaks are visible on the distal portion of the left lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant jaggedness on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe indicate probable historical physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark oval pigment patch (landmark) located on the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the lateral edge toward the notch.
